title: MLA, farmers protest Centre’s ‘failure to release drought relief’ in Karnataka

ai.summary: Karnataka farmers protest Centre's failure to release drought relief funds after state demanded ₹22,400.58 crore under NDRF, citing crop losses across 57.93 lakh hectares.

facts.claim: Karnataka state faced one of its worst droughts in recent history
facts.quote: Mr Patil said the State was facing one of its worst droughts in recent history
with 226 taluks declared drought-hit following a severe deficit in southwest monsoon rainfall in 2026

facts.claim: Crop loss reported across 57.93 lakh hectares
facts.quote: Crop loss had been reported across 57.93 lakh hectares, including 53.92 lakh hectares of crops and 4.01 lakh hectares of horticultural crops

facts.claim: State sought ₹20,585.73 crore in assistance under NDRF
facts.quote: the government of Karnataka had sought ₹20,585.73 crore in assistance under the National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF)

facts.claim: State revised demand to ₹22,400.58 crore after Union Government revised relief norms
facts.quote: Following the revision of relief norms by the Union Government, the State had revised its demand to ₹22,400.58 crore

ai.background_note: Karnataka farmers demanded ₹22,400.58 crore in drought relief funds from Centre after state reported crop losses across 57.93 lakh hectares.
